item.text:
`test/orders.js` exports small shop-order utilities: totals, percentage discount codes, an average price, and a formatted multi-line order summary.

Bugs:

- [calcTotal](C:\Users\Kerim\AppData\Local\Temp\codex-eco-bench-FjSeqS\test\orders.js:5) uses `i <= items.length`. On the final iteration, `items[i]` is `undefined`, so accessing `.price` throws. It should be `i < items.length`.
- Consequently, both [averageItemPrice](C:\Users\Kerim\AppData\Local\Temp\codex-eco-bench-FjSeqS\test\orders.js:20) and [formatOrder](C:\Users\Kerim\AppData\Local\Temp\codex-eco-bench-FjSeqS\test\orders.js:25) also fail for every input because they call `calcTotal`.
- `averageItemPrice` divides an order total (which includes quantities) by the number of line items. If “item price” means average per unit, it should divide by total quantity instead. Empty input also needs an explicit policy; otherwise, after fixing `calcTotal`, it would return `NaN`.
